payload.summary: Found in the Phase 2 exit test: nahel dispatch spawning codex exec hangs/dies silently when the dispatch itself runs inside a detached background shell — dispatch.started journals, then nothing: no child process observable, no exit, no dispatch.ended (two occurrences on speed-count-game, item 9enzs894, runs 2qtta0n8 + bq37q9wj; the same dispatch of claude produced output and a clean failure bracket, and direct codex exec works reliably). Suspects: stdin/tty inheritance of the spawned grandchild (codex exec waits on a pipe that never closes) or process-group signal on parent detach. Repro: run nahel dispatch review from a backgrounded shell with codex routed. Fix direction: dispatch should spawn workers with stdin explicitly closed (</dev/null) and its own process group, and should carry a liveness/timeout bracket so a dead worker still gets dispatch.ended.
